home.subtitle: Visual Designer / Motion Designer
home.name: Hi, I'm Homer Shie
home.bio: I'm Homer, a visual designer with 9 years of experience, now focused on Vue / React frontend development. I transform complex logic into intuitive visual language, capable of defining a product's visual depth and independently delivering the full loop from UI/UX to frontend implementation. I've collaborated long-term with Garmin and received recognition from a Pixar animator during college. I believe AI tools streamline workflows, but great products need more than stable code — they need a visual soul that resonates with users.

about.subtitle:
9 years of visual experience, bringing design concepts to life through code.
I focus on transforming complex logic into intuitive, dynamic digital experiences.
about.bio_p1: Over the past 9 years of visual design, I've deeply participated in diverse commercial projects on a freelance basis. I worked long-term with Garmin, transforming complex wearable device interfaces into compelling visual experiences — the "Muse of Thursday" collaboration honed my precision in motion timing. Years of collaboration across industries gave me deep insight into cross-disciplinary communication.
about.bio_p2: To bridge the gap between design and engineering, I dove into full-stack development, culminating in the MemeDam project. More than a technical exercise, it was a complete product architecture practice — from database ERD design and Redis cache optimization to frontend interactive animations. I love turning static designs into "working logic" through code.
about.bio_p3: As an INTJ, I naturally seek rational, systematic paths within sensory creative work. Whether it's body composition management, playing rock guitar, or immersing in ACG culture — these interests ultimately feed back into my design. I'm not just a visual builder; I'm a logic weaver, committed to making aesthetics more than surface-level, backed by technical depth.

experiences.title: Frontend Engineering & Product Development
experiences.description: Focused on dual-framework development with React/Next.js and Vue/Nuxt3, currently leading the continuous iteration of AniDaze, an anime calendar platform. Demonstrated full-stack capability through MemeDam, where I personally designed the ERD schema, RESTful API, and implemented Redis cache optimization. Committed to transforming nine years of design sensibility into high-quality engineering logic.

Full visual solution capabilities from brand identity to 3D modeling and UI/UX design.
